text: Tracy Jensen, the saved selection for the Alameda at-large mayor race, appears in CAIR-SFBA's tracker as having supported the 2024 Gaza ceasefire letter. In a questionnaire response, she opposed a Gaza ceasefire letter as ineffective and divisive and stated she had worked on eliminating investments in all weapons rather than pursuing an Israel-specific BDS policy. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel as a democratic, inclusive and secure Jewish state, endorsed Jensen in the general phase. Tony Daysog voted against the 2024 ceasefire letter and opposed both the original and amended versions, while Malia Vella was absent from that vote.
